claims.claim: Swish containment is exactly a multiplicity-respecting directed-cycle problem.
claims.evidence: After independently fixing one allowed transformation per selected physical card and directing hoop to ball, the Swish condition gives indegree=outdegree=1 at every used point and zero at every unused point. Following the unique outgoing arc in any nonempty component returns to its start without repetition, so that component is a directed simple cycle. Conversely, distinct physical cards realizing such a cycle give exactly one hoop and one ball at every cycle vertex. Counting occurrences of each transformation type is precisely the physical-copy constraint.
claims.witness: For any cycle p_1→p_2→...→p_r→p_1, the r realizing physical cards form a Swish; from any nonempty Swish, any directed component supplies such a cycle.
claims.search_method: Direct graph-theoretic proof from the source definition, supplemented by exhaustive checking of every loopless directed edge subset on four labelled vertices satisfying the degree condition.

claims.claim: The transformation action gives four position orbits, eight internal card types, and twenty-eight cross-orbit types in fourteen reversal pairs.
claims.evidence: The horizontal and vertical reflections generate a Klein four group. Its position orbits have sizes 4,2,4,2 and are exactly A,B,C,D as stated. Simultaneous action on ordered distinct position pairs gives internal counts 3,1,3,1. For AB,AC,AD,BC,BD,CD, exact orbit enumeration gives 2,4,2,2,2,2 types in each direction. Thus there are 8 internal and 2(2+4+2+2+2+2)=28 cross types. Reversal is a fixed-point-free involution on cross types, producing fourteen pairs.
claims.witness: A={(1,1),(1,3),(4,1),(4,3)}, B={(1,2),(4,2)}, C={(2,1),(2,3),(3,1),(3,3)}, and D={(2,2),(3,2)}; exhaustive diagonal-action enumeration produces exactly 36 card types.
claims.search_method: Reconstructed the Klein action directly from the source transformations and enumerated all 132 ordered distinct position pairs using exact finite sets.

claims.claim: A no-swish collection contains at most 20 distinct transformation types, and this is sharp.
claims.evidence: Both types in any cross reversal pair realize a directed two-cycle, so at most fourteen cross types can occur. On each free four-point orbit, the three internal types are the three nonidentity Klein translations; one card of each realizes a triangle, limiting support there to two. The two-point orbits each contribute at most their sole internal type. Hence support is at most 14+2+1+2+1=20. The stated construction has twenty types and is cycle-free: every cross arc strictly increases A<B<C<D, while the selected internal types contain no cycle.
claims.witness: Take all fourteen forward cross types and the six types represented by (1,1)→(1,3), (1,1)→(4,1), (1,2)→(4,2), (2,1)→(2,3), (2,1)→(3,1), and (2,2)→(3,2).
claims.search_method: Derived the reversal-pair and internal-triangle obstructions, then reconstructed and checked the twenty-type rank-acyclic witness.

claims.claim: Every 60-card once-or-twice model has a 28-card no-swish subset; unless all eight internal types are doubled, it has a 29-card no-swish subset.
claims.evidence: In the explicitly defined model, all 36 types occur and exactly 24 are doubled. If internal multiplicity is M0, every physical cross card is forward in exactly twelve of the 24 orbit orders. Some order therefore has at least ceil((60-M0)/2) forward cards. Adding the six cycle-free internal types remains no-swish because cross arcs strictly increase orbit rank. Since M0≤16, the size is at least 22+6=28. If any internal type is not doubled, M0≤15, giving at least 23+6=29.
claims.witness: Choose an orbit order maximizing forward physical cross cards, retain all such cards, and add one copy of each of the six internal witness types from claim 2.
claims.search_method: Checked the exact 24-order incidence count and every possible internal mass M0 from 8 through 16.

claims.claim: If a once-or-twice model has maximum no-swish size 28, then all eight internal types are doubled and the cross-card multiplicities are directionally balanced between every pair of position orbits.
claims.evidence: Claim 3 forces all eight internal types to be doubled. The remaining 44 physical cards are cross cards, so the average forward count over the 24 orbit orders is 22. If W_ij≠W_ji, choose an order in which i,j are adjacent and swap them. All other pair relations remain unchanged, while the forward count changes by the nonzero quantity W_ji-W_ij. The integer forward counts are therefore nonconstant with average 22, forcing one to be at least 23. Together with the six safe internal cards this would be a 29-card no-swish subset, contradicting maximum 28.
claims.witness: The adjacent-transposition construction explicitly turns any imbalanced pair into two orders with different forward counts; the larger-order construction supplies at least 23 cross cards plus six internal cards.
claims.search_method: Proved the adjacent-swap lemma and exhaustively checked all 148,578 feasible directional duplicate-count profiles with sixteen cross duplicate flags.

claims.claim: When all eight internal types are doubled, any no-swish subset contains at most six internal cards.
claims.evidence: Every internal type is invariant under reversal. Selecting its two physical copies permits opposite realizations on the same two positions, yielding a two-card Swish, so a no-swish subset uses at most one copy per internal type. On A and C, using all three distinct internal types realizes a directed triangle; hence each contributes at most two. B and D each have only one internal type. The total is therefore at most 2+1+2+1=6.
claims.witness: Exact enumeration with multiplicity two gives independent internal maxima (2,1,2,1) on A,B,C,D.
claims.search_method: Enumerated every internal selected submultiset and every realizable directed simple-cycle signature on each position orbit.

claims.claim: For a fixed unordered orbit pair with k reversal pairs and d doubled types in each direction, a no-swish subset contains at most k+d cards between those two orbits.
claims.evidence: Opposite-direction types with the same quotient label form a two-cycle, so active first copies occupy disjoint labels and number at most k. If a type labelled δ supplies a selected second copy in one direction and a distinct label ε supplies one in the other, the four cards realize gH_i→gδH_j→gδεH_i→gεH_j→gH_i. Distinctness modulo H_iH_j makes all four vertices distinct. Thus second-copy bonuses can occur in at most one direction, where only d doubled types exist. There are consequently at most k first copies and d bonuses.
claims.witness: The displayed alternating δ,ε four-cycle is a concrete obstruction whenever bonuses occur in both directions; selecting all k types in one direction and both copies of its d doubled types attains k+d locally.
claims.search_method: Proved the label argument and exhaustively enumerated all 100 balanced local multiplicity profiles and all 110,550 selected submultisets across the six orbit pairs.

claims.claim: Under the once-or-twice model, maximum no-swish size is exactly 28 if and only if all eight internal types are doubled and W_ij=W_ji for every unordered position-orbit pair.
claims.evidence: Necessity follows completely from claims 3 and 4. For sufficiency, doubling all eight internal types leaves sixteen doubled cross types. Balance implies that each unordered orbit pair has d_ij doubled types in each direction, so 2Σd_ij=16 and Σd_ij=8. Claim 6 bounds cross cards in any no-swish subset by Σ(k_ij+d_ij)=14+8=22; claim 5 bounds internal cards by six. Thus the total is at most 28, while claim 3 constructs at least 28. If either condition fails, claims 3 or 4 construct 29, completing both directions.
claims.witness: Every balanced aggregate profile has forward count exactly 22 in each orbit order and total local bound 22; every imbalanced profile has an order with at least 23 forward cards.
claims.search_method: Combined the proved local bounds with exact duplicate accounting and exhaustively enumerated all feasible balanced and imbalanced aggregate profiles.

claims.claim: The sealed source omits information essential to deciding the exact commercial-deck target, even though the once-or-twice abstract model now has an exact criterion.
claims.evidence: The source identifies the commercial deck, the totals 60 and 36, the existence of equivalent cards, and a known 28-card no-swish subset, but supplies no 36-entry multiplicity vector, internal duplication flags, or directional totals. That omission is logically outcome-relevant: two once-or-twice decks satisfying the stronger common aggregate of all 36 types plus exactly 24 duplications have different answers under the verified criterion.
claims.witness: Deck X doubles all eight internal types and both directions of eight reversal pairs; it is balanced and has maximum 28. Deck Y doubles all fourteen backward types, nine forward types, and one internal type; all 23 forward physical cross cards plus the six safe internal cards form a verified 29-card no-swish subset. Both decks have 60 cards and all 36 types.
claims.search_method: Inspected every top-level source field and the source paper text, then independently constructed and checked both aggregate-compatible abstract decks.

target_evidence: The draft does not decide whether the actual commercial deck has maximum no-swish size 28 or at least 29. It instead proves a correct exact criterion for an explicitly stated once-or-twice abstraction and demonstrates that the aggregates available in the sealed source do not determine which side the commercial deck occupies. This is material but incomplete progress on the exact source target, matching the draft's PARTIAL resolution claim.
